title: Ввести EventStore API и in-memory adapter в PHP/Dart
summary: Добавить в оба SDK семантически одинаковые `UncommittedEvent` / `AppendResult` / `EventStreamPage`, `append`/`load` и testkit in-memory store без PostgreSQL.
why: Current ports finish by caller seq; types and local atomic batch/collision can be proved before durable SQL. `RAG:—`.

include: Stream id (tenant+action); uncommitted/committed types; new store methods; in-memory adapter with content-hash classify, assigned seq, synthetic global_position, keyset pagination; mapping onto ALC-5 `ActionEvent`; PHP/Dart tests driven by the P5.1 manifest (non-PostgreSQL cases).
exclude: PostgreSQL adapter; JournalAppender/AuditEventFactory production wiring; package export removal; changing frozen schemas; JCS oracle ownership; live DB; OpenTelemetry SDK.

rules: `append` returns assigned seq range, global_position of the last event, and `appended` vs `idempotent_replay`. `load` is keyset `seq > after` with default 500 / hard max 1000. In-memory still classifies collision vs replay so unit tests fail if they ignore the hash. `EventLog.append(ActionEvent)` is absent from the production interface; test helpers may wrap a one-event batch for frozen three-field assertions. In-memory is testkit/reference-only and cannot be a production constructor default. Do not log payloads or tokens. Do not expose `Any` expected version.
guidance: Keep committed `ActionEvent` as the ALC-5 envelope. Generate event ids with CSPRNG UUID/ULID in helpers, never `ev-{id}-{seq}`. Shared error spellings come from P5.1. Prefer the existing `Canonicalizer` for the collision digest. Test fakes live only in test files.
